name: marketlens
description: Universal, ToS-safe Facebook Marketplace assistant for Chrome/Edge.

scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && npm run postbuild
scripts.postbuild: cp manifest.json dist/ && mkdir -p dist/data dist/assets && cp data/places.json data/places-au.json data/places-nz.json dist/data/ && cp -r assets/* dist/assets/ 2>/dev/null; true
